name: mobile
description: Capacitor wrapper — packages the same web build as native iOS and Android apps.

scripts.mobile:sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync
scripts.mobile:ios: npm run mobile:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.mobile:android: npm run mobile:sync && npx cap open android

next: npm run mobile:add:ios      # generates ios/ (needs Xcode)
npm run mobile:add:android  # generates android/ (needs Android Studio)
npm run mobile:ios          # build, sync, open in Xcode
Live reload on a device: CAP_SERVER_URL=http://<your-lan-ip>:5173 npx cap sync
